method: Each listed image was actually opened; observations concern the displayed result, not a new image reconstruction.

observations: All eligible records are shown with equal u/v scales, with no hidden clipping of the extreme blue and low-v records. Counts and the outside-613 audit scope are stated.

The additional 601 native-supported points are overlaid on retained prior values; 12 newly unit-resolved but colour-withheld records are excluded. Fnu/Flambda markers identify prior conventions, not physical classes.
Raw SDSS and DESI means show a common broad rise into the green, with a visible red continuum difference and broad signed-blue noise.
The existing shared-gri correction reduces the visible red mismatch but leaves imperfect agreement and SDSS scatter.
The separate PS1-only original-grid sensitivity also leaves visible scatter; it is not an independent validation of common photometry.
AND/OR exclusions are displayed as separate mask sensitivities. OR removes extensive support and its diagnostic integral must be withheld.
All shown physical uv conditions remain displaced above the Planck segment. Equal geometric scales avoid changing the apparent vector directions.
The proper-motion-propagated Gaia position remains slightly outside the nominal 1-arcsec fibre radius; the point is not an association posterior.

scope_limits: These eight supplementary panels overlap the 613 reviewed records and do not add eight new objects or independent observations. Node viewer checks are separate from actual static-image review.
